## 📄 Appendices

### Appendix A: Metric Definitions and Calculations

#### Portfolio Level Metrics
**Epic Lead Time:**
- **Definition:** Time from epic entering funnel to completion
- **Calculation:** Done Date - Funnel Entry Date
- **Target:** <20 weeks for standard epics

**Portfolio ROI:**
- **Definition:** Return on investment across all portfolio initiatives
- **Calculation:** (Benefits - Investment) / Investment × 100
- **Target:** >150% annually

#### Program Level Metrics
**Program Predictability:**
- **Definition:** Percentage of PI objectives achieved vs. planned
- **Calculation:** (Actual Business Value / Planned Business Value) × 100
- **Target:** >80% consistently

#### Team Level Metrics
**Team Velocity:**
- **Definition:** Average story points completed per iteration
- **Calculation:** Sum of completed story points / Number of iterations
- **Target:** Consistent with team capacity, not increasing velocity

### Appendix B: Escalation Procedures

#### Performance Alert Thresholds
| Level | Threshold | Response Time | Escalation Path |
|-------|-----------|---------------|-----------------|
| Green | Within target range | Monthly review | Standard reporting |
| Yellow | 10-20% deviation | 48 hours | Manager notification |
| Red | >20% deviation | 24 hours | Executive escalation |
| Critical | Business impact | Immediate | Crisis response team |

### Appendix C: Tool Configuration and Access

#### Dashboard Access Rights
| Role | Access Level | Tools | Permissions |
|------|--------------|-------|-------------|

| Scrum Master | Team Level | Team Boards | Edit team metrics |

## When to Use

Use throughout the project lifecycle to identify, assess, and track risks. This template is essential for projects with significant complexity, multiple stakeholders, or high business impact, where structured risk management provides decision-making value.

## When NOT to Use

Do not use for very low-risk, short-duration tasks where informal risk awareness is sufficient. Avoid this template if your governance framework requires a different risk management approach or if stakeholders prefer real-time risk dashboards over static registers.
